verdict.rationale: The evidence shows card capture happening on Square's side: Square hardware and Terminal API checkout, Tap to Pay via the Mobile Payments SDK, and payments created from opaque source IDs such as card-on-file tokens rather than raw card numbers. Together these imply reduced developer exposure to card data, but nothing in the pack mentions PCI, reader certification or the developer's remaining compliance obligations. Missing for 10: explicit PCI scope documentation, evidence of certified/end-to-end encrypted readers, vendor guidance on remaining merchant/developer obligations (e.g. SAQ type), independent corroboration.
